data.cultural_impact: The surname Kapoor holds great cultural significance in India and beyond, where it is associated with the Indian film industry, particularly in the Bollywood sector. The Kapoor family is a leading Bollywood dynasty, having produced several renowned actors and filmmakers. As a result, the name has come to represent creativity, innovation, and excellence in the field of entertainment.
data.spiritual_significance: In its original form, the name Kapoor carries a profound spiritual significance, as it is believed to be a reminder of one's essential connection to the divine. It is also believed to serve as a constant inspiration to live in accordance with the virtues of Lord Krishna, such as kindness, selflessness, and a deep understanding of the interconnectedness of all beings.
